title: PPO clipping, advantage signs and empirical KL

chapters.text: Start near the old policy. Current ratio: 0.4; Advantage: 1; Clipped objective: 0.4.
Move the probability ratio. Current ratio: 0.7; Advantage: 1; Clipped objective: 0.7.
Approach the clipping boundary. Current ratio: 1; Advantage: 1; Clipped objective: 1.
Cross into the flat region. Current ratio: 1.3; Advantage: 1; Clipped objective: 1.2.
Compare advantage signs. Current ratio: 1.6; Advantage: 1; Clipped objective: 1.2.
